result.summary: Found 1 major issue: a section title is displaying a raw localization key instead of human-readable text.

issues.description: The section title shows the raw string key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of the intended localized label (e.g., 'Popular' or 'Popular near you').
issues.suggestion: Update the app's localization/string resources so that the 'home_feed.popular_title' key resolves to the correct translated text for the current locale.
